name: Spiritual Agony, Lesser
body:
School enchantment [pain]; Level adept 2, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, lathspell 1, occultist 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration see text
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You instill a divinely-empowered creature with pain.

The target must be a creature with class levels in a class that grants divine spellcasting or has supernatural abilities that draw their power from a divine source. It also affects aligned outsiders. The target takes 4d8 nonlethal damage and is nauseated for 1 round, then sickened for 1 minute. A successful saving throw halves the damage and reduces the condition to sickened for 1d4 rounds.
